svg.text: vigneshwar@github ~ cat story.md

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: I am Vigneshwar. I write backend and systems code, and I help train the models that

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: are starting to write it too. This is the long version of how that happened.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 2023 — starting

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: I started B.Tech Computer Science in Tamil Nadu with very little idea what I was

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: doing. The first programs I wrote barely ran. What changed things was realising that

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: almost everything worth learning was already written down, in public, in other

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: people's repositories. So I started reading them. I still do, most days.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 2024 — going lower

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: I got tired of not knowing what was underneath. C++ first, then Rust, which I picked

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: because it refuses to let you stay vague about ownership and lifetimes. Learning it

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: was slow and occasionally humiliating, and it taught me more about how machines

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: actually work than the two years before it combined.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 2025 — building the hard thing

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: I wrote FluxDB, a time-series database, from scratch in Rust. Not because the world

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: needed another one, but because I wanted to find out where the cost really lives

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: inside a storage engine: columnar compression, a write path worth benchmarking, and

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: a great deal of profiling. Then rustkvd, a distributed key-value store with Raft

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: consensus, an LSM engine and MVCC, for the same reason applied to consensus.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 2026 — open source, and models

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: I started contributing upstream: OpenTelemetry, CNCF, Helm, oxc, ripgrep. Working in

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: codebases that size teaches one specific skill — reading unfamiliar code well enough

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: to change it without breaking anything, then taking the review that follows

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: seriously. Much of what I contributed was tests, because tests are how you find out

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: whether you actually understood the thing you just read.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Alongside that I began working with Shipd (Datacurve) and Handshake AI, authoring

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: training data and grading model output against detailed rubrics, plus a run of

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: freelance work for startups, founders and co-founders — usually as the only engineer

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: on the project, from scoping through to deployment.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: now

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Still building systems. Still reading more code than I write. If you are hiring for

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: backend, systems or cloud-native work, or you want something built properly, the

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: contact details are at the top of this page.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
